column8: The original package test target is represented by dedicated parser_format_package_source integration targets in both owning Rust crates and is exercised together by the package campaign.
Every top-level test in the sole upstream test file has an exact COVERED row and executes through dedicated Rust package tests.

Both upstream indent and flat vectors execute with identical outputs and write counts through the Rust-native typed-fragment formatter; Rust formatting replaces Go runtime printf parsing and arbitrary byte strings normalize to UTF-8.
All 15 upstream flag/output cases execute exactly, including zero flags, DefaultRestoreFlags, quote escaping, case conversion, and source priority when mutually exclusive flags are combined.
Both feature-id forms and the upstream callback-error identity/partial-output semantics execute through the writer-bound Rust restore context.
